<documents>
<document id="transfers-brookpay">
SendingˆmoneyˆwithˆBrookPayˆBrookPayˆletsˆyouˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆanotherˆTallowbrookˆmemberˆbyˆphoneˆnumber,ˆemailˆorˆusername.ˆIt'sˆfree,ˆitˆworksˆeveryˆday,ˆandˆtheˆmoneyˆarrivesˆinˆseconds.ˆ##ˆSendˆmoneyˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆBrookPay.ˆChooseˆtheˆperson,ˆenterˆtheˆamountˆandˆconfirm.ˆTheˆrecipientˆseesˆtheˆmoneyˆstraightˆaway.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆBrookPayˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆlimitedˆtoˆ$500.ˆ##ˆBrookPayˆcan'tˆbeˆreversedˆOnceˆaˆBrookPayˆpaymentˆisˆsent,ˆitˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆorˆpulledˆback,ˆevenˆbyˆsupport.ˆOnlyˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆpeopleˆyouˆknow.ˆIfˆyouˆsentˆmoneyˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆperson,ˆaskˆthemˆtoˆsendˆitˆback.ˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆyouˆwereˆscammed,ˆreportˆitˆtoˆusˆrightˆaway.ˆ##ˆFeesˆBrookPayˆcostsˆ$0.00ˆonˆeveryˆplan.ˆBrookPayˆonlyˆworksˆbetweenˆTallowbrookˆmembers.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="close-reopen">
ReopeningˆaˆclosedˆaccountˆClosedˆaccountsˆcan'tˆbeˆreopened.ˆIfˆyou'dˆlikeˆtoˆcomeˆback,ˆapplyˆforˆaˆnewˆaccountˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆWhatˆaˆnewˆaccountˆmeansˆ-ˆNewˆaccountˆandˆcardˆnumbersˆ-ˆNewˆverification.ˆYou'llˆgoˆthroughˆidentityˆchecksˆagain.ˆ-ˆYourˆoldˆtransactionˆhistoryˆstaysˆwithˆtheˆclosedˆaccount.ˆ-ˆAnyˆcooling-offˆrefundˆforˆaˆfirstˆpaidˆplanˆchargeˆonlyˆappliesˆonceˆperˆperson.ˆ##ˆStatementsˆfromˆtheˆoldˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆdownloadˆstatementsˆforˆ90ˆdaysˆafterˆclosing.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆmessageˆsupportˆtoˆrequestˆthem.ˆ##ˆIfˆweˆclosedˆyourˆaccountˆIfˆTallowbrookˆclosedˆyourˆaccount,ˆforˆexampleˆafterˆaˆreview,ˆyouˆmayˆnotˆbeˆableˆtoˆopenˆaˆnewˆone.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆreverseˆthatˆdecision.ˆ##ˆInactiveˆaccountsˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆwasˆclosedˆforˆinactivity,ˆyouˆcanˆapplyˆagainˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆ##ˆYourˆoldˆaccountˆdetailsˆUpdateˆyourˆemployerˆandˆanyˆcompaniesˆthatˆpaidˆintoˆyourˆoldˆaccount.ˆPaymentsˆsentˆtoˆaˆclosedˆaccountˆareˆreturnedˆtoˆtheˆsender.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="support-third-parties">
Canˆsomeoneˆelseˆmanageˆmyˆaccount?ˆTallowbrookˆaccountsˆbelongˆtoˆoneˆperson.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆjointˆaccountsˆorˆauthorizedˆusers,ˆandˆsupportˆonlyˆactsˆforˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆinˆtheirˆownˆsigned-inˆsession.ˆ##ˆWhatˆthatˆmeansˆ-ˆWeˆcan'tˆdiscussˆanˆaccountˆwithˆaˆspouse,ˆpartner,ˆparent,ˆchildˆorˆfriend,ˆevenˆifˆtheyˆknowˆtheˆaccountˆdetails.ˆ-ˆWeˆcan'tˆmakeˆchangesˆbecauseˆsomeoneˆelseˆasks,ˆevenˆifˆthey'reˆmessagingˆfromˆtheˆaccountˆholder'sˆphone.ˆ-ˆWeˆcan'tˆconfirmˆwhetherˆaˆpersonˆhasˆaˆTallowbrookˆaccount.ˆ##ˆHelpingˆsomeoneˆwithˆtheirˆaccountˆTheˆaccountˆholderˆcanˆsitˆwithˆyouˆandˆmessageˆusˆfromˆtheirˆownˆsession.ˆWe'llˆtalkˆtoˆthemˆdirectly.ˆ##ˆLegalˆauthorityˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆpowerˆofˆattorney,ˆorˆyou'reˆhandlingˆtheˆaccountˆofˆsomeoneˆwhoˆhasˆdied,ˆweˆcanˆhelpˆthroughˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam.ˆSeeˆ"Powerˆofˆattorney"ˆandˆ"Ifˆanˆaccountˆholderˆhasˆdied".ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆsomeoneˆisˆmisusingˆyourˆaccountˆIfˆsomeoneˆelseˆisˆusingˆyourˆaccountˆwithoutˆyourˆpermission,ˆorˆpressuringˆyouˆoverˆyourˆmoney,ˆtellˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSeeˆ"Ifˆsomeoneˆisˆcontrollingˆyourˆmoney".ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
